limitations: Kinematic human body (IK-driven); no whole-body balance, muscle or human contact simulation.
assisted_grasp: carried objects and pulled/rotated parts follow the hand through an explicit attachment; not a frictional grasp.
contact_dynamics: only the receiving device part is simulated in MuJoCo; the fingertip is a kinematic mocap proxy.
device_motor: internal part motion (turntable) is an authored actuator track.
illustrative_effect: lights, display and paper output are authored visual effects; no heating, printing or electronics are simulated.
